performers.name: Nova Sky
performers.showDescription: Opened with a 40-foot LED dove descending from the roof as she sang her hit 'Satellite Heart' while dancers formed constellations around her.
performers.crowdReaction: The entire stadium lit up with phone flashlights during the chorus, creating a galaxy effect that trended worldwide.

performers.name: The Midnight Howlers
performers.showDescription: Launched into a pyrotechnic guitar solo atop a rotating stage shaped like a wolf's head, flames shooting from its eyes.
performers.crowdReaction: Older fans roared approval while younger viewers posted the wolf stage to social media instantly.

performers.name: Kingston Blaze
performers.showDescription: Brought out a 50-person marching band from his hometown to perform a brass-heavy remix of his anthem 'Crown City'.
performers.crowdReaction: The stadium floor shook as fans stomped in unison with the drumline, creating a seismic moment.

performers.name: Maya Rivers
performers.showDescription: Rode onto the field on a white horse pulling a vintage pickup truck stage, performing 'Dirt Road Diamond' with a full string section.
performers.crowdReaction: Country fans sang every word while non-fans admitted the horse entrance was undeniably cool.

performers.name: Pulse Theory
performers.showDescription: Transformed the field into a giant equalizer with 500 dancers in light-up suits pulsing to the beat of 'Neon Blood'.
performers.crowdReaction: The synchronized light show left the crowd mesmerized, though some complained it was too loud for TV.

performers.name: Diego Luna y Fuego
performers.showDescription: Led a carnival parade with 200 dancers, drummers, and stilt walkers performing a medley ending in a fireworks waterfall.
performers.crowdReaction: The Latin crowd went wild, teaching the entire stadium the chorus chant by the second verse.

performers.name: Jett Carson
performers.showDescription: Smashed three guitars during a medley, culminating in a stage dive into a crowd of veterans he invited on field.
performers.crowdReaction: Pure rock energy had the stadium headbanging, though the broadcast cut away from the guitar smashing.

performers.name: Aria Quinn
performers.showDescription: Floated above the field in a crystal sphere singing 'Gravity' before the sphere opened into a flower of dancers.
performers.crowdReaction: The visual stunned viewers, becoming the most-replayed halftime moment of the year.

performers.name: Bishop & The Saints
performers.showDescription: Performed on a replica city block, bringing out surprise guest choir for a gospel-rap fusion of 'Hometown Hero'.
performers.crowdReaction: The choir gave fans chills, with many calling it the most soulful halftime ever.

performers.name: Sierra West
performers.showDescription: Played a stripped-down acoustic set on a barn stage that rose from the field, joined by a surprise legend for a duet.
performers.crowdReaction: The intimate vibe was a risky change of pace that paid off with a massive singalong.

performers.name: Vector
performers.showDescription: DJ'd from inside a giant robot that walked across the field, lasers shooting from its fingertips in time with drops.
performers.crowdReaction: EDM fans lost their minds while traditionalists called it a video game, both watched intently.

performers.name: Luna Mar
performers.showDescription: Performed a salsa-reggaeton fusion atop a rotating platform with 30 dancers, confetti cannons firing in team colors.
performers.crowdReaction: The dance break sparked an instant TikTok trend copied in stadiums nationwide.

performers.name: The Vagabonds
performers.showDescription: Played a 12-minute epic starting with a single spotlight and building to full pyrotechnics and a 20-piece orchestra.
performers.crowdReaction: Critics praised the musicianship while casual fans checked their phones during the long intro.

performers.name: Zara Luxe
performers.showDescription: Changed costumes four times in three minutes via quick-change magic, each outfit lighting up the field differently.
performers.crowdReaction: Fashion Twitter exploded, debating which look was best while the performance continued.

performers.name: Mack Drayton
performers.showDescription: Rapped while walking through a recreation of his childhood neighborhood built on the 50-yard line.
performers.crowdReaction: The storytelling resonated deeply, with many calling it the most personal halftime show ever.

performers.name: Canyon Creek
performers.showDescription: Brought a full bluegrass band and performed a foot-stomping hoedown that had players dancing on the sideline.
performers.crowdReaction: Even rival fans were clapping along by the final fiddle solo.

performers.name: Neon Dreams
performers.showDescription: Created a silent disco where the stadium heard the music through distributed headphones, TV viewers heard the mix.
performers.crowdReaction: The visual of 70,000 people dancing in silence was surreal and unforgettable.

performers.name: Isla Sol
performers.showDescription: Performed a powerful ballad while aerialists spun above her, ending with a dove release over the crowd.
performers.crowdReaction: The emotional performance had many in tears, a stark contrast to typical party shows.

performers.name: Ryder Kane
performers.showDescription: Played guitar while riding a motorcycle around a circular stage, sparks flying from the tires.
performers.crowdReaction: The stunt was pure rock theater, earning a standing ovation from the whole stadium.

performers.name: Cassidy Rae
performers.showDescription: Sang a medley of her hits while floating platforms carried her and dancers across the field like lily pads.
performers.crowdReaction: The choreography was flawless, though some missed the vocals under the spectacle.

performers.name: True North
performers.showDescription: Performed with a live orchestra reimagining his biggest hits, wearing a custom suit made of LED panels.
performers.crowdReaction: The fusion of classical and hip-hop won over skeptics and critics alike.

performers.name: Wyatt Boone
performers.showDescription: Drove a monster truck onto the field and performed from the roof, crushing old guitars underneath.
performers.crowdReaction: The country-rock crowd ate it up, calling it the most American halftime ever.

performers.name: Kairo
performers.showDescription: Used AI-generated visuals that reacted in real time to crowd noise, creating a unique show for that stadium only.
performers.crowdReaction: Tech fans were fascinated, others just enjoyed the trippy visuals.

performers.name: Carmen Delgado
performers.showDescription: Led a massive conga line that snaked through the entire field, pulling in players and coaches.
performers.crowdReaction: The inclusive, joyful energy was infectious, with the whole stadium dancing.

performers.name: Steel Harbor
performers.showDescription: Performed inside a cage that lowered from the roof, breaking out during the final chorus with an explosion.
performers.crowdReaction: The dramatic escape had everyone on their feet screaming.

performers.name: Jade Monroe
performers.showDescription: Sang while 100 children from local choirs joined her for an anthem about unity, all wearing white.
performers.crowdReaction: The heartwarming moment transcended music, becoming a cultural touchstone.

performers.name: Pharaoh
performers.showDescription: Built a pyramid stage piece by piece during the set, standing atop it for the finale as gold confetti rained.
performers.crowdReaction: The symbolism and scale impressed everyone, cementing his superstar status.

performers.name: Hollis McCray
performers.showDescription: Performed a tribute to troops with a military band, ending with a flyover timed to the final note.
performers.crowdReaction: The patriotic display earned the loudest cheer of the night, with veterans saluting.

performers.name: Synthwave
performers.showDescription: Recreated an 80s arcade on the field, performing inside a giant Pac-Man maze with dancers as ghosts.
performers.crowdReaction: Nostalgia hit hard for Gen X and Millennials, who sang along to every synth line.

performers.name: Elena Cruz
performers.showDescription: Fused flamenco with reggaeton, her dress lighting up with each stomp as dancers clapped complex rhythms.
performers.crowdReaction: The artistry stunned the crowd into silence before erupting in applause.

performers.name: Blacktop Saints
performers.showDescription: Played a gritty set on a stage made to look like a garage, complete with oil stains and toolboxes as instruments.
performers.crowdReaction: The raw, authentic vibe was a refreshing change from overproduced shows.

performers.name: Skye Bennett
performers.showDescription: Performed a zero-gravity routine using wires, appearing to swim through the air above the field.
performers.crowdReaction: The illusion was so convincing many thought it was real magic.

performers.name: Donnie Cash
performers.showDescription: Threw actual cash with his face on it into the crowd during 'Money Talk', totaling $100,000.
performers.crowdReaction: Chaos ensued as fans scrambled, making it the most talked-about stunt in years.

performers.name: Dusty Trails
performers.showDescription: Performed around a campfire with storytelling between songs, intimate despite the massive venue.
performers.crowdReaction: The quiet moments were surprisingly powerful in a stadium of 70,000.

performers.name: Orbit
performers.showDescription: DJ'd from a rotating planetarium dome projecting stars across the entire stadium roof.
performers.crowdReaction: Fans lay on their backs watching the cosmos, creating a peaceful interlude.

performers.name: Sofia Reyes
performers.showDescription: Brought 50 mariachi musicians for a powerful rendition of her hit, trumpets blaring from every corner.
performers.crowdReaction: The sheer volume and passion overwhelmed the stadium in the best way.

performers.name: Ironclad
performers.showDescription: Performed a heavy metal set with actual blacksmiths forging a steel logo on stage during the show.
performers.crowdReaction: The sparks and sound created a visceral experience metal fans still talk about.

performers.name: Talia Voss
performers.showDescription: Did the entire show in reverse, starting with the finale and rewinding to the beginning via video screens.
performers.crowdReaction: The mind-bending concept confused some but delighted art-pop fans.

performers.name: Lil Jett
performers.showDescription: At just 19, became youngest halftime headliner, bringing out his high school marching band.
performers.crowdReaction: The youthful energy was infectious, inspiring a new generation of fans.

performers.name: The Wilder Brothers
performers.showDescription: Three brothers performed a harmony-rich set on a porch swing that floated above the field.
performers.crowdReaction: The tight harmonies gave everyone goosebumps, a masterclass in vocals.
